facts.fact: 剃净的胡子让 Perla 失望：少了他看重的「老成气派」，像少了胡子就「年轻了」——她怕镇上说「绝望老处女嫁了个男孩」。
facts.anchor: In a way, she thought of him as a precious stone she’d found by chance at a bazaar.

facts.fact: 晚饭桌 Cándido 抛出侦探之事；Ulises 谎称是找同公寓旧住户「欠债的」Lagos——Perla 注意到他事先没提。
facts.anchor: “By the way, I heard a funny story that a man was looking for you earlier today, Mr. Linares,” Cándido said as he reached for his glass, interrupting her thoughts. “A detective.”

facts.fact: 办公室密谈：Cándido 断言「他是骗子」，把父亲送的三十岁生日手枪留给 Perla 防身；她骂他「白痴」但把枪收进抽屉。
facts.anchor: “He’s a stranger and might be the friend of thieves. A thief himself,” he said, and took out his pistol, which he placed upon the desk. “Your father gave me this as a gift for my thirtieth birthday, do you remember? I think you ought to have it from now on.”

facts.fact: 夜里她盯着镜子里的丈夫起疑：「买的不是纯种马，是没有血统的马」；提出去墨西哥城卖器材当蜜月，他推脱「朋友在旅行」「以后再说」——她逐字分析出「空洞、排练过」。
facts.anchor: She had the nagging sensation that rather than purchasing a thoroughbred, she’d bought a horse without a pedigree.

facts.fact: 闪回：推妹之后的几个月她怕 Inés 揭发谋杀；孩子重新开口后「似乎全忘了」——她的刑罚是无聊的日子本身。
facts.anchor: For a few months she fears her niece will reveal the truth, that she will accuse Perla of murder. But the child does not speak, and when she does begin to talk, she seems to have forgotten all about that day when Encarnación tumbled down the stairs.

facts.fact: 闪回：父亲的拐杖与吼叫、母亲的鸦片酊呓语、侄女的哭闹、房客的抱怨——「这是地狱，我被恶魔围困」。
facts.anchor: There are also the responsibilities of the household, of the guests, and now that Encarnación is dead, the rearing of her daughter. Her father yells, her mother breaks a cup, somewhere the girl weeps, and the guests have complaints about the tough meat served for supper the previous day.

facts.fact: 闪回：放贷点子来自 Encarnación 的借款民俗回忆；Cándido 说「淑女做这营生不像话」，父亲说「这正是用你的地方」，Perla 回敬「体面？破鞋一双？」——生意开张。
facts.anchor: She discusses her plan with her father and with Cándido.

facts.fact: 闪回：30 岁在港口广场被陌生男人搭讪——「不是 Perla 张开腿，是另一个人」，用「不是我」完成匿名；从此每次去港口都找无名男人。
facts.anchor: Later, try as she might, she does not remember much of their conversation.

facts.fact: 双面人生成型：好女儿与荡妇耶洗别；Cándido 持枪收债「不是她的错」；镇上依然敬重 Inclán 小姐。
facts.anchor: She can be the good daughter and the sinful Jezebel.

facts.fact: 她对侄女眼睛的恐惧：觉得那双黑眼睛能剥皮见心；「真希望把那双眼睛挖出来盛在瓷盘里」。
facts.anchor: Sometimes, when her niece sits across the table from Perla and looks at her, she thinks the girl knows everything.

facts.fact: 恐惧解除：女孩移开视线——「没人知道。谁也不会想到世上有两个 Perla」；她安心喝茶。
facts.anchor: But then the girl glances away and Perla realizes Inés does not know.
